# awscc_wellarchitected_agent_goal (Resource)

Resource schema for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentGoal. An Agent Goal expresses a Well-Architected objective (a title, optional description, and the pillars it targets) within an Agent Profile, used to focus Well-Architected Agent recommendations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pillars` (Set of String) The list of Well-Architected pillars this goal targets.
- `profile_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parent Agent Profile that owns this goal. Pass `!Ref` of the parent AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfile to flow its ARN here.
- `title` (String) The title of the Agent Goal.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the Agent Goal.

### Read-Only

- `agent_goal_id` (String) The service-generated unique identifier of the Agent Goal.
- `arn` (String) The synthetic Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Goal, composed of the parent profile ARN and the goal id.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the goal was created.
- `created_by` (String) The identifier of the system or user that created this goal.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_at` (String) The timestamp when the goal was last modified.
- `last_modified_by` (String) The identifier of the system or user that last modified this goal.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wellarchitected_agent_goal.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The synthetic Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Goal, composed of the parent profile ARN and the goal id

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wellarchitected_agent_goal.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_wellarchitected_agent_goal.example "arn"
```
